title: Three-month focus playbook — Q1→Q2 personal OKRs (draft)
content:
Purpose / intent:
- Short, actionable personal plan to protect deep work time, move three measurable outcomes forward, and experiment with two productivity changes.
- Treat this like a sprint backlog + a living log — lightweight and ugly is fine.

Quarterly theme (Jan–Mar, updated):
- "Focus > Heroics": fewer scattered projects, more finish-rate. Prioritize reliability improvements and one high-impact product feature.

Objective 1 (O1): Improve reliability of the embeddings cache pipeline so it costs less and returns fewer stale results.
- Key result 1.1: Reduce cache miss rate from baseline 28% → <= 12% by end of quarter. (metric: weekly cache-miss dashboard)
- Key result 1.2: Drop average per-embedding cost by 18% via batch sizing + quantization guidance.
- Leading indicators: PR velocity on cache tuning tasks, e2e test coverage for cache invalidation.
- Next actions (week-by-week):
  - Week A: run sampling analysis (INF-725), assemble 2–3 failing query patterns.
  - Week B: prototype prefix caching op and perf test on dev cluster.
  - Week C: A/B run on small cohort; measure miss rate + tail latency.
  - Week D: roll to dedicated pool with fallback checks.

Objective 2 (O2): Ship the Q2 developer demo for low-latency streaming + tool-calls with a polished script.
- Key result 2.1: Demo latency under 350ms p95 for 1–4 concurrent users.
- Key result 2.2: Demo script + runbook written and dry-run with 2 engineers.
- Constraints: need final model pin and staging capacity reserved.
- Notes: prioritize stability over bells — fewer modes, better fallback behavior.

Objective 3 (O3): Personal craft — reduce meeting overload and increase focus ratio to 60% of weekly hours.
- Metric: weekly focus ratio = (deep work hours) / (total working hours). Baseline: 42%. Target: 60%.
- Tactics:
  - Time-block 10:00–13:00 deep work M/Tu/Th; no Slack/meetings.
  - Use 25–50 minute sprints with 5 minute breaks.
  - Office hours for async reviews: Wed 15:00–16:00 (keep quick feedback windows).

Weekly check-in template (used every Friday):
- Wins this week (2 lines):
  - 
- Blockers / decisions needed:
  - 
- Progress vs KRs (numbers):
  -
- Experiments running and early signals:
  -
- Energy / context notes: (sleep, travel, focus)
  -

Example scratch entry — 2026-02-19:
- Wins: prototype reduced batch count by combining short sequences — cost down estimated 9% on sample workload.
- Blocker: staging cluster OOM during 1M-step perf run (need infra pause window).
- Progress: cache-miss sampling done (baseline 28%); identified top 3 query families.
- Experiments: try KV compression + small-token batching next week.
- Energy: tired after travel; reduced afternoon focus.

Risk register (short bullets):
- Infrastructure capacity: could delay A/B if dedicated pool not reserved — action: ask infra to hold slot (INF-725).
- Quality regressions from quantization: add small eval bucket + automatic rollbacks.
- Meeting creep: escalate recurring invites that are not high impact.

Personal experiments (two-week runs):
1) "No-meet Mornings" — block mornings M/Tu/Th and auto-decline external invites. Measure focus ratio and PR output.
2) "Micro-planning Sunday" — 20 minutes Sunday evening to outline 3 top work items for the week; measure drop in decision time.
3) "Energy-first scheduling" — move heavy analysis to morning; schedule 30-minute walks after lunch.

Notes to self (chaotic, leave as-is):
- If demo runway is tight, deprioritize secondary features like multi-tool chaining and keep single reliable tool.
- Keep a mini-runbook for post-demo rollback — include simple curl fallbacks and static tokens.
- Ask Priya for her checklist on canary metrics (linked artifacts above).

Open questions / decisions by Mar 1:
- Pin model for demo: use 6B quantized variant or 13B slower but higher quality? (lean 6B for latency target)
- Reserve how much Dedicated capacity for perf runs? (talk to infra, propose 2x peak for 48h window)

Todo (next 7 days):
- [ ] Run full cache sampling and tag top 5 patterns (priority)
- [ ] Prototype prefix caching patch + perf harness
- [ ] Schedule demo dry-run with Alex (target two weeks from now)
- [ ] Auto-decline meetings for blocked mornings
- [ ] Reach out to Infra for staging slot (INF-725)

Helpful links / quick refs:
- INF-725 (jira): https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-725
- Personal playbook page (confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/PL-331-personal-playbook
- Cost dashboard: /dashboards/embeddings-cost (internal)

Retro / end-of-quarter one-pager (template):
- What shipped? 3 bullets.
- Biggest blocker and how it was addressed.
- Metrics achieved vs target.
- What to stop / start next quarter.
- Personal note: did focus ratio improve? If not, why?

Last quick thought: keep the doc messy. The point is to make actionable micro-decisions and reduce cognitive load when things stall.

"Notes to self: if overwhelmed, switch to single KR sprint for two weeks and triage meetings."
